text.content:
If it has wheels, he'll put a bounty on it.

Role: Fixer
Known for: Car jobs: bounties on particular makes and models, resold through his Autofixer business

El Capitán offers all sorts of gigs, but cars are his thing. He posts bounties on specific vehicles and sells them on once they're brought in.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.27
